name: cuda-core
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cuda-core
  version: "1.3.0"
  number: 0
  # The pinned CCCL submodule commit of cuda_core/third_party/cccl at the release tag.
  cccl_commit: ba8eb88fb78254a07112e60d4e74cac84038fac8
  target_name: ${{ "sbsa-linux" if aarch64 else 'x86_64-linux' if linux else "arm64" if win and arm64 else "x64" if win else "" }}
  subdir: ${{ "targets/" ~ target_name if aarch64 or linux else "Library\\" if win else "" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-python/releases/download/${{ name }}-v${{ version }}/cuda-python-${{ name }}-v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 690dc3759871f250d14871ad0c55eac141ed95910f269762d6930fb3e58b23c8
  # Since 1.3.0 the build requires the pinned CCCL submodule, which the release archive does not include.
  - url: https://github.com/NVIDIA/cccl/archive/${{ cccl_commit }}.tar.gz
    sha256: e313702117a93a323c11e69f61c6040ffb5adc7aeb193b9b88d86a7009e1d91a
    target_directory: cuda_core/third_party/cccl

build:
  number: ${{ number }}
  string: cuda${{ cuda_major_version }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  # conda-forge does not ship CPython builds for win-arm64 until PY314
  # CUDA 12 does not support WoA
  skip: match(python, "<3.11") or ppc64le or osx or (win and arm64 and (match(python, "<3.14") or cuda_major_version == "12"))
  script:
    # keep `file` explicit: a script mapping without file/content is invalid per the recipe-format schema
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}
    env:
      SUBDIR: ${{ subdir }}
      # clang-tidy is a lint step of upstream CI, not needed to build the package.
      CUDA_PYTHON_SKIP_CLANG_TIDY: "1"
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: win
        then:
          - "*/torch_cpu.dll"
          - "*/torch_python.dll"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
        - cython >=3.2.5,<3.3
  host:
    - cython >=3.2.5,<3.3
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm >=8
    - cuda-cudart-dev
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev
    - cuda-profiler-api
    - cuda-pathfinder >=1.5
    # The build requires a cuda.h of the same major.minor as the cuda-bindings it builds against.
    - if: cuda_major_version == "12"
      then:
        - cuda-bindings 12.9.*
        - cuda-version 12.9.*
      else:
        - cuda-bindings 13.5.*
        - cuda-version 13.5.*
        # CUDA 13 moved crt/host_defines.h, which cuda_runtime_api.h includes, out of cuda-cudart-dev.
        - cuda-crt-dev_${{ target_platform }}
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - cuda-pathfinder >=1.4.2,<2
    # The cuda-bindings floor of this release (cu12 and cu13 extras in pyproject.toml).
    - if: cuda_major_version == "12"
      then: cuda-bindings >=12.9.8,<13
      else: cuda-bindings >=13.5.0,<14
    - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x", upper_bound="x") }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    from_package:
      - cuda-cudart-dev
      - cuda-nvrtc-dev

tests:
  - script:
      - python -c "from cuda.core import Device, Buffer, utils; print('ok')"

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: cuda_core/LICENSE
  summary: "cuda.core: pythonic CUDA module"
  description: |
    cuda.core bridges Python's productivity with CUDA's performance through intuitive and pythonic APIs.
    The mission is to provide users full access to all of the core CUDA features in Python, such as
    runtime control, compiler and linker.
  homepage: https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-python/cuda-core
  repository: https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-python
  documentation: https://nvidia.github.io/cuda-python/cuda-core

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/cuda-python
    - bdice
    - leofang
    - kkraus14
